$schema_note: Curated initial destination dataset for TravelAgent's MVP, approved by the user on 2026-08-29. Not yet loaded into a Django model — the Destination model itself is a Phase 4 (Joint Review) deliverable per PROJECT_STATE.md. This file is the source of truth to seed that model once it exists.
